claims.text: Severe room-temperature cold rolling of CoCrFeMnNi induces localized high dislocation densities.
Cold-rolling-induced dislocations promote short-range ordering or local solute rearrangement at prior-deformation grain boundaries.
Localized grain-boundary ordering or solute rearrangement creates preferential crack-initiation sites under cryogenic tensile loading.
These localized modifications degrade toughness relative to a fully recrystallized, homogeneous CoCrFeMnNi control.
The starting CoCrFeMnNi alloy is homogeneous and single-phase FCC.
The controlled comparison uses heavy cold rolling at true strain greater than 1.5 versus full recrystallization annealing.
Annealing can produce a fully recrystallized comparison state after cold rolling.
Residual strain fields are concentrated at prior-deformation grain boundaries in the cold-rolled samples.
A high density of deformation defects hardens the material.
Short-range order or localized solute clustering reduces grain-boundary cohesion.
Grain-boundary segregation or brittle grain-boundary phases can substantially reduce ductility in CoCrFeMnNi.
Cryogenic temperatures further suppress ductility and amplify the detrimental effect of localized ordering.
Cold-rolled samples will have lower fracture toughness than fully recrystallized samples during cryogenic testing.
Cold-rolled samples will transition toward brittle fracture modes relative to fully recrystallized controls.
Local ordering or solute clusters will be pronounced at grain boundaries in deformed samples and absent in recrystallized specimens.
Fully recrystallized specimens retain a homogeneous single-phase microstructure with minimal localized grain-boundary ordering.
Fully recrystallized specimens exhibit ductile behavior and higher cryogenic toughness than cold-rolled specimens.
The proposed mechanism is limited to low-temperature service because reduced thermal activation makes local-ordering effects more pronounced.
Applicability at higher temperatures or under different loading conditions remains undetermined.
